findings.spec_constraint: ISO 17442 LEI (20 characters) for Entity responsible for reporting; Boolean (TRUE/FALSE) for Reporting obligation of the counterparty 2
findings.evidence_quote: Identifies the entity legally responsible for reporting on behalf of both counterparties where that responsibility is assigned by EMIR... States whether counterparty 2 itself has a reporting obligation under EMIR, regardless of who is actually responsible for submitting that report.
findings.reasoning: EMIR REFIT provides specific fields that cover both parts of the requirement. 'Entity responsible for reporting' captures the LEI of the entity legally responsible under EMIR (such as an FC reporting under mandatory delegated reporting), and 'Reporting obligation of the counterparty 2' captures whether Counterparty 2 is subject to an EMIR reporting obligation via a boolean value.
